decks.notes: The deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early with aggressive Goblin creatures and utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Aether Vial to quickly get creatures onto the battlefield. It also includes a toolbox strategy with cards like Goblin Matron and Boggart Harbinger to tutor for specific Goblins for various situations. The deck can also generate value through sacrificing Goblins for effects like damage or card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker provide powerful late-game options to close out the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents through tempo plays while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It utilizes efficient removal spells and countermagic to control the board and protect its threats. The key concept revolves around utilizing Dimir colors to create a fast-paced game plan that disrupts the opponent's strategy while maintaining a consistent source of threats. The deck aims to control the pace of the game and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of disruption and aggression to secure victory.

This deck is focused on using aggressive creatures and powerful disruptive enchantments to control the board and overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while also playing efficient and threatening creatures like Fury and Pyrogoyf, the deck aims to apply pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also utilizes fast mana acceleration like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to power out its threats early and punish opponents for relying on non-basic lands.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth while using Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and control the board with cards like Solitude and Skyclave Apparition. The goal is to pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard, while utilizing powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat to finish off the game. The deck also has a toolbox approach, with cards like Flickerwisp and Mother of Runes providing versatility and answers to various threats.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize fast and efficient creatures like Blighted Agent and Glistener Elf, along with spells like Berserk and Invigorate, to quickly deal lethal poison damage to the opponent. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Legolas's Quick Reflexes and Embiggen further enhances the effectiveness of the infect strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive infect strategy while maintaining some level of control over the game.

The main focus of this deck is utilizing Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp up mana quickly and cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck includes cards like Primeval Titan and Crop Rotation to search for lands efficiently, as well as counterspells and disruption cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command to control the game and protect your big threats. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and mana advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy powerful threats and disrupt the opponent's mana base. By utilizing cards like Magus of the Moon and Seasoned Dungeoneer, the deck aims to generate early pressure and prevent the opponent from casting their spells effectively. The inclusion of cards like Cavern of Souls and Chrome Mox allows for efficient mana production and protection for key creatures. Overall, the deck aims to take control of the game early on and maintain pressure to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly cheating big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Archon of Cruelty into play by using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It also utilizes other powerful combo pieces like Omniscience and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, while also digging through the deck for key pieces with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The strategy is to quickly establish a dominant board presence and win the game before opponents can effectively respond.

The main focus of this Aggro-Burn Legacy deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost burn spells and fast creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide. With a heavy reliance on direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Chain Lightning, along with burn enchantments like Price of Progress, the strategy is to reduce the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. The deck also includes cards like Roiling Vortex and Fireblast to help maintain pressure and finish off the opponent swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a combination of aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with a suite of burn spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning. The goal is to keep up the pressure with a steady stream of damage while disrupting the opponent with cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Price of Progress. The deck aims to win the game as quickly as possible by overwhelming the opponent with a barrage of direct damage and efficient creatures.

This deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent through aggressive creature attacks and burn spells. Cards like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear provide early pressure, while spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning target the opponent directly. Price of Progress punishes nonbasic lands, while Slickshot Show-Off and Twinferno provide additional damage. Roiling Vortex disrupts the opponent's strategy, while Fireblast can finish off the opponent. The deck is designed to win the game before the opponent can stabilize or gain control of the board.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill through the library and then use Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for a win. The deck is packed with interaction like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo, along with card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. Urza's Saga provides additional value by searching for key artifacts like Shuko. The deck is designed to be fast and resilient, capable of winning the game in just a few turns.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize a combination of cards to quickly bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard, while also disrupting opponent's strategies with counterspells and removal. The deck aims to efficiently use cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to cheat out creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty, while also using cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Fatal Push and Brazen Borrower to control the board and ensure its combo can go off smoothly.

This deck aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Force of Will and disruptive creatures like Brazen Borrower. It also uses removal spells like Fatal Push to keep the board clear and tempo advantage with cards like Daze. The key strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with a mix of removal, disruption, and threats, ultimately controlling the pace of the game and winning through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while deploying threats quickly to apply constant pressure. Utilizing cards like Stifle and Daze to counter spells and disrupt the opponent's mana base, the deck aims to control the game tempo. Psychic Frog and Murktide Regent provide strong threats that can close out the game quickly, while cards like Fatal Push and Sinkhole remove key threats from the opponent's board. The deck also includes a strong mana denial package with Wasteland and Sinkhole to keep the opponent on the back foot.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand, and then using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Shallow Grave to bring them back into play for a devastating attack. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Unmask to protect the combo and control the opponent's board. The goal is to combine fast mana acceleration with efficient reanimation to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.
